title: Austin Special Election Results Certified
summary:
*   Austin leaders convened a special meeting to formally address the outcomes of a special municipal election held just two days prior.
*   The council officially adopted a resolution to canvass the returns and declare the results of the August 8th special election, making the voter decisions official.
*   This administrative task was completed efficiently, with the entire meeting concluding in just 14 minutes.

Austin City Council

SPECIAL CALLED MEETING

Mayor Todd called to order the Special Called Meeting of the Council, noting the absence
of Mayor Pro Tem Urdy and Councilmember Reynolds. The Mayor announced the purpose of the
meeting was to to canvass the election of August 8, 1992.
1. Consider a resolution canvassing the returns and declaring the results of the August 8,
1992 Special Municipal Election Motion The Council, on Councilmember Nofziger's motion,
Councilmember Larson's second, adopted a resolution canvassing the returns and declaring
the results of the August 8, 1992 Special Municipal Election at 10:10 A.M. C.S.D.T. Motion
passed on a 5-0 Vote, with Mayor Pro Tem Urdy, and Councilmember Reynolds absent. 2.
Adjournment
Motion
The Special Called Meeting of the Council was adjourned at 10:14 A.M., on Councilmember
Epstein's motion, Councilmember Garcia's second, 5-0 Vote, Mayor Pro Tem Urdy and
Councilmember Reynolds absent.
